name: artcraft
description: ArtCraft is an intentional crafting engine for artists, designers, and filmmakers
readmeHtml:
ArtCraft

The IDE for artists.

artcraft-new-demo.mp4

Watch the two-minute ArtCraft demo on YouTube

Download ArtCraft · GitHub releases · Build from source

ArtCraft is the IDE for interactive AI image and video creation. Compose in 2D, stage scenes in 3D, and choose the models that fit your work. Turn prompting into crafting with visual tools for precise, repeatable results.

Show, Don't Tell: Advanced Crafting Features

Artists need control over composition, character identity, and camera placement. Build the scene before you generate it. Click any preview to view it at full size.

Feature Preview
Image to Location
Place virtual actors in a consistent environment and plan multiple shots in the same room.
3D Image Compositing
Layer backdrops, foregrounds, and props in 3D to build compositions with depth.
2D Image Compositing
Compose a scene with image layers, background removal, and drawing tools.
Image to 3D Mesh
Turn an image into a 3D object you can position, rotate, and frame precisely.
Character Posing
Pose characters and set your camera before generating the final shot.
Scene Blocking with Kitbashing
Combine 3D asset kits to control camera angles, object placement, and depth.
Character Identity Transfer
Use a posed mannequin to guide the placement and pose of your character.
Background Removal
Isolate subjects to use as props, layers, or backdrops in 2D and 3D scenes.
Mixed Asset Crafting
Combine image cutouts, worlds, and 3D meshes in one scene.

More previews are coming for scene blocking, canvas editing, and scene relighting.

Quick and Easy Prompting

Start with a prompt when you want to explore an idea quickly, then use the canvas and scene tools to refine it.

Feature Preview
Text to Image
Explore ideas across a wide range of image models with a text prompt.
Prompted Image Editing
Describe changes to an image with models such as Nano Banana Pro and GPT Image.
Canvas Image Editing
Use drawing, masks, and inpainting to guide exactly where an image changes.
Image to Video
Animate an image with your choice of video models and generation controls.

More previews are coming for image inpainting and image ingredients.

aiSummary.oneLiner: ArtCraft is an IDE for interactive AI image and video creation with 2D compositing and 3D scene staging.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: ArtCraft functions as a comprehensive integrated development environment designed specifically for artists working with AI models. It moves beyond simple text prompting by offering visual tools for precise, repeatable results. Users can compose scenes in 2D, stage complex environments in 3D, and integrate multiple assets like backdrops, foregrounds, and props. The platform supports a vast catalog of over 60 models across image, video, music, and 3D generation, enabling a highly controlled and iterative creative workflow.
keyFeatures: Three-D image compositing: Layers backdrops, foregrounds, and props in a 3D space to build compositions with realistic depth.
Two-D image compositing: Composes scenes using image layers, background removal, and integrated drawing tools.
Image to 3D mesh: Converts 2D images into 3D objects that can be positioned, rotated, and framed precisely.
Character posing: Allows users to pose characters and set camera angles before generating final shots.
Scene blocking with kitbashing: Combines 3D asset kits to control camera angles, object placement, and depth.
Character identity transfer: Uses posed mannequins to guide the placement and exact posture of characters.
Background removal: Isolates subjects to be used as props, layers, or backdrops in both 2D and 3D scenes.
Image to location: Places virtual actors into 3D scenes.

useCases.title: Plan consistent cinematic shots
useCases.description: Create and stage multiple shots of characters within a consistent 3D room environment to maintain visual continuity.

useCases.title: Build complex layered scenes
useCases.description: Layer backdrops and foreground elements using 3D image compositing to achieve realistic depth in final compositions.

useCases.title: Control character poses
useCases.description: Pose virtual mannequins and set camera angles precisely before generation, ensuring the AI outputs exactly match the intended vision.

useCases.title: Convert images to 3D props
useCases.description: Turn flat images into manipulatable 3D meshes for precise positioning and framing within a larger staged scene.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: ArtCraft is built for digital artists, AI creators, and directors who need precise control over their generated media. It requires users to be familiar with composing scenes, working with layers, and prompting AI models for image and video generation.
